description: Na₂ZnB₆O₁₁ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.62 Å. Zn is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.90 Å) and one longer (1.97 Å) Zn-O bond length. There are three inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.37 Å) and one longer (1.41 Å) B-O bond length. In the second B site, B is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.35-1.41 Å. In the third B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form corner-sharing BO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.47 Å) and one longer (1.54 Å) B-O bond length. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to two equivalent Na and two B atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two B atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and two B atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Zn and two equivalent B atoms. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one B atom.
